name: worklog-band
description: Shows this session's running worklog interval above the prompt: switch or rebook its category, stop it (drives your wl command)

wl.title: wl command
wl.description: Path to the wl command that books the worklog. A relative path counts from the session's project root (e.g. bin/wl); where it is not executable the band stays hidden. Empty = band off.

log.title: Worklog file
log.description: The file wl writes, one line per entry: ISO_TIMESTAMP|SESSION|CATEGORY|comment. ~ is your home folder.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The categories wl takes, comma-separated, in hotkey order (1-9): CATEGORY or CATEGORY=Label or CATEGORY=Label|Short. The band's button shows Label, the picker row Short.
